title: IIT Kharagpur Internship
description: I interned at IIT Kharagpur as a Machine Learning Engineer, where I worked on a project to develop a Multi Document research Paper Summarizer Model. I was responsible for designing and implementing the model, as well as conducting experiments and analyzing the results. My contributions were instrumental in improving the accuracy and efficiency of the summarization process.

title: SRFP at IIT Ropar Internship
description: I interned at IIT Ropar for a 2 month internship where I built a fully functional Student Management System using MERN stack. The project was envisioned to be implemented in all major Indian Government portals for Education.
